# Data Model

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Entities

Source: `supabase/migrations/*.sql` (11 files) + `lib/types/database.ts` (generated row types) + `lib/types/domain.ts` (domain aliases/joins).

#### Lookup tables — `roles`, `statuses`, `priorities`, `event_types`

- Common shape (`20260916141342_create_lookup_tables.sql`): `id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid()`, `name varchar not null`, `slug varchar not null unique`, `is_active boolean not null default true`, `created_at`/`updated_at timestamptz` (via shared `set_updated_at()` trigger). `statuses` and `priorities` additionally have `sort_order integer not null unique` (workflow/severity ordering); `roles` and `event_types` additionally have `description text`.
- Seeded rows (`supabase/seed.sql`, idempotent on `slug`):
  - `roles`: `obra`, `suprimentos`, `gestao`.
  - `statuses` (by `sort_order`): `solicitado`(1), `em_analise`(2), `em_compra_preparacao`(3), `aguardando_entrega`(4), `entregue`(5), `cancelado`(6).
  - `priorities`: `baixa`(1), `normal`(2), `alta`(3), `urgente`(4).
  - `event_types`: `criacao_pedido`, `mudanca_status`, `alteracao_responsavel`, `alteracao_prioridade`, `alteracao_previsao`, `cancelamento`, `entrega`.
- Invariant: categorical fields are always modeled as an FK to one of these tables, never a Postgres `enum` (stated convention in the migration file header).

#### `profiles`

- `id uuid pk references auth.users(id) on delete cascade`, `full_name varchar not null`, `role_id uuid not null references roles(id)`, `is_active boolean default true`, `is_demo boolean default false`, timestamps (`20260916141348_create_profiles_table.sql`).
- Domain type `Profile` (`lib/types/domain.ts`) extends `ProfileRow` with a resolved `role: Role`.
- Provisioned exclusively by the `handle_new_user()` trigger on `auth.users` insert (`20260916150000_add_profile_provisioning_trigger.sql`) — reads `role_slug`/`full_name` from `raw_user_meta_data`; raises an exception if `role_slug` doesn't resolve to a `roles.slug`. No client-writable insert path.

#### `obras`

- `id uuid pk`, `name varchar not null`, `is_active boolean default true`, `is_demo boolean default false`, timestamps (`20260916141353_create_obras_table.sql`).

#### `obra_profile` (join table)

- Composite PK `(obra_id, profile_id)`, both FK'd (`obras`, `profiles`), plus `created_at` (`20260916141410_create_obra_profile_table.sql`). Many-to-many between obras and `obra`-role profiles.

#### `pedidos` — the central entity

- `id uuid pk`, `code varchar not null unique`, `obra_id uuid not null references obras(id)`, `requester_id uuid not null references profiles(id)`, `requested_at timestamptz default now()`, `needed_at date not null`, `items_description text not null`, `status_id uuid not null references statuses(id)`, `priority_id uuid references priorities(id)` (nullable), `responsible_id uuid references profiles(id)` (nullable), `expected_delivery_at date` (nullable), `is_demo boolean default false`, timestamps (`20260916141400_create_pedidos_table.sql`).
- `code` is generated by `next_pedido_code()` (sequence `pedidos_code_seq`), format `PED-######` (`lib/pedidos/code.ts` `PEDIDO_CODE_PATTERN = /^PED-\d{6}$/`).
- Invariants (enforced in `lib/pedidos/service.ts`, reinforced by RLS): `status_id` transitions restricted to `ACTIVE_NON_FINAL_STATUSES` ∪ `entregue`/`cancelado`; once `entregue`/`cancelado`, immutable; `priority_id`/`responsible_id`/`expected_delivery_at` writable only by `suprimentos`.
- Domain joins: `PedidoComRelacoes` (obra, status, priority, requester, responsible resolved) and `PedidoComHistorico` (+ ordered `events`) in `lib/types/domain.ts`, built by `PEDIDO_SELECT`/`PEDIDO_WITH_HISTORICO_SELECT` in `lib/pedidos/queries.ts`.

#### `pedido_events` — append-only audit trail

- `id uuid pk`, `pedido_id uuid not null references pedidos(id)`, `event_type_id uuid not null references event_types(id)`, `previous_value text` (nullable), `new_value text` (nullable), `actor_id uuid not null references profiles(id)`, `created_at timestamptz default now()` — no `updated_at`, no update trigger (`20260916141403_create_pedido_events_table.sql`: "Insert-only ... since history is never edited").
- Written exclusively by `lib/pedidos/service.ts`'s `insertEvent`, one row per mutation (see `domain_rules.md` event-type mapping table).

### Storage

| Aspect | Value |
|---|---|
| Engine | PostgreSQL, via Supabase (`supabase/config.toml` local project config) |
| Schema location | `supabase/migrations/*.sql`, 11 timestamped files, applied in filename order |
| Migration tool | Supabase CLI migrations (no separate ORM/migration framework — plain `.sql` files) |
| Seed data | `supabase/seed.sql` (idempotent lookup rows) + `lib/demo/{seed,data,reset}.ts` + `scripts/seed-demo.ts`/`scripts/reset-demo.ts` (demo dataset, tagged `is_demo = true` and `[DEMO]`-prefixed names, `lib/demo/data.ts` `DEMO_PREFIX`) |
| Indexes | `idx_pedidos_obra_id_status_id`, `idx_pedidos_needed_at`, `idx_pedido_events_pedido_id_created_at` (`20260916141416_add_pedidos_query_indexes.sql`) — support Kanban grouping, filtered listings, and the history timeline |
| Access control | Row Level Security on every `public` table (`20260916141421_enable_row_level_security.sql`), policies in `20260916150500_add_rls_policies.sql`; service-role key (`lib/supabase/admin.ts`) bypasses RLS entirely for server-trusted write paths |
| Generated types | `lib/types/database.ts` (row types per table: `EventTypeRow`, `ObraRow`, `PedidoRow`, `PedidoEventRow`, `PriorityRow`, `ProfileRow`, `RoleRow`, `StatusRow`, `ObraProfileRow`) |

### Cache

- No in-memory cache/store (no Redis/Memcached dependency in `package.json`, no `cache`/`lru` utility modules found under `lib/`).
- Next.js's built-in router/data cache is invalidated explicitly per mutation via `revalidatePath` calls in `app/suprimentos/actions.ts`'s `revalidatePedidoPaths` (`/suprimentos`, `/suprimentos/pedidos`, `/suprimentos/pedidos/{code}`, `/obra`, `/obra/{code}`, `/gestao`, `/gestao/kanban`, `/gestao/pedidos`, `/gestao/pedidos/{code}`) — this is invalidation of Next's route cache, not an application-level data cache.
